Removing

Refitting

- Position the vehicle on a lift.

- [4410B10]

- Position a hydraulic support to work safely.

1. Undo the bolt fixing the toe in rod to the stub axle.

2. Undo the bolt fixing the toe in rod to the frame.

3. Remove the toe in rod.

Refitting

Removing

- Fit the toe in rod.

- Tighten the bolts fixing the toe in rod to the frame and to the stub axle.

- [4410B10]

- Place the vehicle in Standard "A" conditions, in other words with the vehicle mass complete, spare wheel, tool kit, all supplies and accessories (oil, engine coolant, etc.) and a full fuel tank.

- Check that the tyre inflation pressure is correct.

- Position the vehicle on a support so that the wheels are resting on the ground.

- Check that after having placed the vehicle in standard "A" conditions, the measurement "D"-"C" corresponds to the figure given in the table below.
